name: Almost Heaven Watoga 2-4 Person Classic Barrel Sauna, 6x5 ft.
description: Almost Heaven Watoga 6'x5' DIY Barrel Sauna Kit Sauna alone or with a few friends; the choice is yours with the Almost Heaven Watoga! This 6’x5’ barrel sauna fits up to four people, and with the upgraded Harvia 6 kW electric heater you will easily reach temperatures up to 195ºF. If the party starts later, delay the start time up to eight hours while you prepare, and expect a fully heated sauna when the time is right. Indoors or out, the Almost Heaven Watoga DIY barrel sauna is ready to turn your house into a home. Features Below are some features and specifications of the Almost Heaven Watoga 2–4 person barrel sauna: Ball-and-socket lumber: 1 3/8" thick Any glass features are tempered Stainless steel bands, hinges, and fasteners Interior LED light Sauna stones included Weather-resistant plastic support cradles Two opposite-facing benches for sitting or reclining Indoor or outdoor usage Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Best-in-class electric heater and sauna stones Made in the USA Specifications Almost Heaven Watoga 2–4 person barrel sauna holds two to four people Heater size: 4.5kW, 240V, 30-amp requirement, hardwire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Assembled size: 72"W x 59"D x 77"H Interior room size: 71"W x 51"D x 71"H Bench dimensions: 18"W x 51"L x 17"H Cradle dimensions 54" x 6 Shipping weight: 635 lbs Shipping size: 74"L x 41"W x 48"H Note: All dimensions are approximate Options & Customizations Lumber type: Choose between two types of rustic cedar for Almost Heaven Watoga, red and onyx (stained)! Rustic cedar has a slightly red hue amongst the knots and boasts a pleasant cedar aroma. Lumber provided is 1 ⅜” thick to ensure a fully heated sauna room. Vista rear window: Open the barrel sauna interior to breathtaking views with the addition of the vista rear window. This 20” x 36” piece of 3/8” glass sits on the back end barrel, above the electric heater. Door style: Outfit your sauna with one of the following three door options: deluxe glass, wood with a window, or all-wood. Heater: You can upgrade the Almost Heaven Watoga from the standard 4.5kW heater to a 6kW. Care & Maintenance Almost Heaven’s 2–4 person barrel sauna is a traditional sauna, which requires very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping & Assembly The Almost Heaven Watoga will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. See shipping tab for more details. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are some sauna accessories essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Resources Almost Heaven Barrel Sauna Installation & Owner’s Manual Videos
